# Security and data handling

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security issues privately to the repository owner through GitHub. Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability or accidental sensitive-data disclosure.

## Research data

Only public, de-identified, or appropriately authorized data may be used in this repository. Raw data, participant-level exports, access tokens, credentials, and machine-specific secrets must remain outside version control. If sensitive information is committed, stop sharing the repository, rotate any exposed credentials, and contact the repository owner immediately.

This research code is not a clinical system and must not be used for diagnosis or treatment decisions.
